a survey was distributed to veterinary clinics throughout Wyoming to assess changes in canine leptospirosis vaccination rates
Public health authorities investigated to determine potential sources of infection, identify additional cases, and recommend control measures.
WDH staff members reviewed medical records, interviewed the patient, and reviewed reportable conditions data*
Six of 10 clinics in the affected city and eight clinics in rural counties responded.
The National Electronic Disease Surveillance System for Wyoming was used to monitor for additional cases.

equity.equity_measurement: Rurality applies only to veterinary clinics (non-human units), so it is not an SPD.

notes: The human component is a single case report; the 13 canine cases are described only.
